title: humanize: tooling update rewrites byte formatting
notes: A pre-commit update whose lint auto-fix turned %-formatting into f-strings. The story is only the commit message.

defects.summary: naturalsize() prints float byte counts below the base with all their decimals: 1.123456789 gives '1.123456789 Bytes' instead of '1 Bytes' (and '1.123456789B' with gnu=True).
defects.trigger: a float value below 1000 (or 1024 with gnu/binary), e.g. naturalsize(1.123456789)
defects.caught_if: a condition formats a non-integer byte count below the unit threshold and checks the output is a whole number of bytes, as before the change
defects.observed: at fb61d5a naturalsize(1.123456789) returned '1.123456789 Bytes' (gnu: '1.123456789B'); the later fix makes it '1 Bytes'
